who-we-are.title: Who We Are
who-we-are.subtitle: Discover Farada's story and our journey in providing the best coffee experience for our valued customers
who-we-are.our-story-desc: Farada was established in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia with the goal of providing the best types of coffee and high-quality products for our valued customers. We believe that coffee is not just a drink, but a unique experience that combines authenticity and modernity.
who-we-are.our-vision-desc: We strive to be the first choice for coffee lovers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the region, through providing high-quality products and exceptional customer service that makes every visit an unforgettable experience.
who-we-are.our-mission-desc: Providing the best types of coffee and carefully selected products, while maintaining the highest standards of quality and service. We are committed to providing a unique consumer experience worthy of our valued customers.
who-we-are.quality-desc: We choose the best products and ensure their high quality
who-we-are.honesty-desc: We deal with our customers with complete honesty and transparency
who-we-are.innovation-desc: We always strive to develop our services and provide new things
who-we-are.our-experience-desc: We have years of experience in the coffee and high-quality products field. Our team of specialized experts ensures providing the best advice and products suitable for your needs.
who-we-are.community-commitment-desc: We believe in the importance of social responsibility and participate in many community initiatives. We strive to build strong relationships with our local community and provide support for charitable and educational projects.
who-we-are.our-future-desc: We plan to expand into new areas and provide more innovative products and services. Our goal is to be the trusted partner for coffee lovers throughout the Kingdom.
who-we-are.join-us-coffee: Join us on the coffee journey
who-we-are.join-us-coffee-desc: Discover a world of distinctive flavors and exceptional service with Farada

sale-terms.subtitle: Terms and conditions governing the sale of products through our website
sale-terms.purchase-orders-desc: When placing an order, you confirm that all information provided is accurate and complete. We reserve the right to reject any order if the information is incorrect.

sale-terms.warranty-desc: All our products are guaranteed against manufacturing defects. The warranty covers a specific period that varies by product type. The warranty does not cover damage caused by improper use.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your personal information
privacy.introduction-desc: This Privacy Policy explains how Farada collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you visit our website or use our services.
privacy.information-collected-desc: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, make a purchase, or contact us.
privacy.how-we-use-desc: We use the information we collect to process your orders, communicate with you, and improve our services.
privacy.information-sharing-desc: We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personal information to third parties without your consent.
privacy.information-protection-desc: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access or disclosure.
privacy.cookies-desc: We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience and analyze website traffic.
privacy.your-rights-desc: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information at any time.
privacy.policy-changes-desc: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page.
privacy.contact-us-desc: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us.

cookies.title: Cookies Policy
cookies.subtitle: How we use cookies and similar technologies on our website
cookies.what-are-cookies-desc: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your device when you visit our website.
cookies.types-of-cookies-desc: We use essential cookies for website functionality, analytics cookies to understand usage, and marketing cookies for personalized content.
cookies.how-we-use-desc: Cookies help us provide you with a better experience by remembering your preferences and analyzing website traffic.
cookies.third-party-cookies-desc: Some cookies are placed by third-party services that appear on our pages, such as analytics and social media plugins.
cookies.cookie-management-desc: You can control and manage cookies through your browser settings. However, disabling cookies may affect website functionality.
cookies.disabling-cookies-desc: Most browsers allow you to refuse cookies or delete them. Please refer to your browser's help section for instructions.
cookies.policy-updates-desc: We may update this Cookies Policy from time to time. Please check this page regularly for updates.
cookies.contact-us-desc: If you have any questions about our use of cookies, please contact us.
